name: SMRITI Landed Cost Manual Allocation

fields.label: Cost Line Row Ref
fields.description: Stores the stable Frappe child-row 'name' of the parent SMRITI Landed Cost Line entry this manual amount applies to. NEVER a positional/display index -- same immutability principle as purchase_receipt_row in the Audit Snapshot (see Section 3.2, Revision D). Populated by client script when the user opens the manual allocation grid for a cost line.

fields.label: Cost Component
fields.description: Fetched from the linked Cost Line on row creation (client script). Read-only here -- the source of truth is the Cost Line. Stored redundantly for UI readability and filtering without joining back to the parent table.

fields.label: Purchase Receipt
fields.description: The Purchase Receipt this row's manual allocation applies to. Used by on_submit to resolve the correct snapshot row.

fields.label: Receipt Item Row Ref
fields.description: Stable Frappe child-row 'name' of the Purchase Receipt Item this amount is allocated to. NEVER a positional index. Matches the same identifier stored in SMRITI Allocation Audit Snapshot.purchase_receipt_row, enabling an exact join at on_submit time without ambiguity under row reordering.

fields.label: Item
fields.description: Fetched from the Purchase Receipt Item row on population (client script). Read-only display aid -- the authoritative join key is purchase_receipt_row, not this field.

fields.label: Qty
fields.description: Pulled from the Purchase Receipt Item row for display context only. Helps the user sanity-check their manual allocation amount relative to quantity without switching screens.

fields.label: Base Value (Row Share)
fields.description: = qty x rate for this receipt item row. Displayed so the user can see the proportional weight of this row before entering a manual amount. Computed and written by client script at population time.

fields.label: Allocated Amount
fields.description: The user-entered manual cost allocation for this specific (Cost Line x Receipt Item Row) pair. Must be >= 0 (enforced by on_submit validation -- see validation_spec.md Section 2.3). The sum of all rows sharing the same cost_line_ref must equal the Cost Line amount within the configured tolerance (default 0.01).

_spec_reference: SMRITI_Landed_Cost_Spec_v1.md Gap Resolution G1, Revision E. Gap: the original schema had no persistence layer for Manual allocation inputs entered during Draft state, causing on_submit to have no data source when allocation_basis = Manual. Resolution: this child DocType, linked as 'manual_allocations' on SMRITI Landed Cost Allocation, provides the stable keyed store. Grain: one row per (Cost Line Row Ref x Purchase Receipt Item Row Ref) pair. Populated by client script when user enters the manual allocation grid; read by get_manual_allocation_from_db() in on_submit. Immutability: rows are not deleted on Cancel per Section 1.3 -- they remain as the input record of what the user intended at submission time.
